Classifies the hazard from the intensity maps of the events of 30, 100 and 200 years of return period: two hazard maps, IP1 and IP2, with classes from 2 (low) to 4 (high).

**Toolbox folder:** Hydro-Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Flooding, Hazard<br>
**Authors:** Silvia Franceschi, Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.HazardClassifier`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inIntensityTr200` | raster file |  |  | The intensity map of the event of 200 years of return period. |
| `inIntensityTr100` | raster file |  |  | The intensity map of the event of 100 years of return period. |
| `inIntensityTr30` | raster file |  |  | The intensity map of the event of 30 years of return period. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outHazardIP1` | output file |  | The hazard map IP1: 2 low, 3 medium, 4 high. |
| `outHazardIP2` | output file |  | The hazard map IP2: 2 low, 3 medium, 4 high. |
